package.name: auro_controller
package.description: Perception-to-LLM-to-Arm controller bridge for the AURO robotic pick-and-place system. Receives raw object detections from overhead_perception, validates coordinates against table bounds, transforms to the ground frame, and forwards valid objects to the LLM node. After the user selects an object via the LLM, triggers the Kinova arm pick-place sequence.
